title: Yatiñampi qillqtʼat iwxtʼanaka
intro: Mä jaqi jakʼan saytʼatäkasmas ukham amuytʼañäni, jupax janiw milagronakampi ni reinonakampi uñtʼatäkiti, jan ukasti jichhürunakansa chuymanakar irpki uka arunakampiw uñtʼatäski. Aka Allah luqtirix mä wali aski regalo katuqatayna ukat yuspajarañ sapa iwxt’awinak mä munat wayna yatiqirir churataparux warantatayna.
clues: Allah-an yatiñampiw bendicitäna, ukat ukat yuspärañatakiw kamachitäna.
Wawajarojj wali munasiñampiw ewjjtʼayäta, munasiñampi ukat llakisiñampiw ewjjtʼayäta.
Allah ukamp chikt’atäñax wali jach’a jan waliwa sasaw wawajarux sista.
Wawajarojj mayisiñ uttʼayañapatakiw ewjjtʼta, kunatï cheqäki uk mayiñapataki, jan walinak jarkʼañapataki ukat pacienciampi aguantañapatakiw ewjjtʼta.
Wawajarojj janiw jachʼa jachʼa tukusajj ajanupar kuttʼayañapäkiti, janirakiw jachʼa jachʼa tukusajj aka oraqen sarnaqañapäkiti sasaw ewjjtʼayäta.
Wawajarojj mä jukʼa ritmonïñapataki ukat arup jiskʼachañapatakiw yatichta, kunattejj asnonakan wararitapaw jukʼamp qhoru arunak istʼasi.

outcome.answer: Yuspajarañ uñacht’ayañataki ukhamarak awk taykan wali yatiñan iwxt’awinakaparjama

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
